# C0 machines against Algocell's own executors (generated by `impact_study.py equiv`)

Git 9a658f83d319, zilion ed93b7c3aecd, adapter Apple M4 (Metal, IntegratedGPU), 2026-10-11 01:57; 59 s of work in 2 resumable chunks (longest 49 s).

For every world of the impact study, its C0 machine (`imp_<world>_c0`, Zilion compat '0.2') and Algocell's own single-pair executor for that world (the exported `shader/z80_test_*.wgsl`; `MEM_LENGTH` derivation for L = 19, see impact_worlds.py) run the same pairs with the same step budget, suppression masks and run seed (one dispatch each, lane = case index). Pairs: lattice-neighbour pairs (well-mixed partners for Stage H) drawn from the archived soups of every registered condition run in that world (2,000 per condition, stream 0xE0, uniformly over the condition's worlds and cells), grouped by the condition's budget and suppression set; plus 20,000 uniform random pairs without masks and with random masks (1 opcode in 6 on every page). Compared per pair: the final memory (2L bytes), writes into A and into B (+ padding), and the registers a f b c d e h l sp pc.

**Result: 53 of 53 worlds with 0 mismatches.** Negative controls: 67 of 67 show mismatches, as they must.
